name: Full functionality closure contract
question: If the plan is executed successfully, will extensions be fully functional and measured without overclaiming partial evidence?
finding_before: Section 9 had a final acceptance matrix but not a single closure bundle tying all required packets together.
The final report could still overclaim full functionality from a subset of runtime, token, quality, learnability, target/rollback, documentation, or review evidence.
recheck_evidence: Plan now allows a full-functionality claim only when all closure rows have packet-backed PASS evidence and the final report names the exact hosts, scenarios, machines, checkpoints, datasets, and approval tracks covered.
